checked_sources: Independent finite RREF enumeration for K₁,₁ and K₁,₂ over F₂
correctness.rationale: For any ideal, W is its projection to A⊕B and D its intersection with Z. For fixed W,D the exact ideal condition is [W,A⊕B]⊆D and the lifts are all graphs of linear maps W→Z/D. Their count is q^(dim W·(ab−dim D)), with no gradedness restriction. Independent bracketing against the two factors gives [W,A⊕B]=A′⊗B+A⊗B′, with intersection A′⊗B′, so its dimension is rb+as−rs. Once the projections A′,B′ are chosen, their two quotient kernels of codimension h and a quotient isomorphism describe W bijectively, giving the Gaussian and GL factors and dim W=r+s−h. Counting D in the remaining central quotient establishes all terms including zero projections and h=0. Alternation and the argument still hold in characteristic two. An independent RREF enumeration checked K₁,₁ and K₁,₂ over F₂ (16 and 374 subspaces, yielding [1,1,3,1] and [1,3,7,7,7,1]); no universal inference is made from these counts.
residual_risks: The independent finite test covers only two prime-field cases; the arbitrary-q conclusion rests on the field-linear proof.

originality.rationale: Exact earlier coverage is established by the distinct Resultary record f31f1793ea7b. It gives the same polynomial for the same Lie bracket, all a,b≥1, every prime power, and all linear ideals. Put c=(a−r)(b−s)=ab−k(r,s), replace its quotient parameter k by the frozen h, and set its central quotient dimension t=d−k(r,s). Every Gaussian factor, lift exponent and power of T then agrees. The graph-lift and Goursat classifications are also already in that record.
residual_risks: The full extent of earlier DVR-derived finite-field coverage is not settled here; this cannot undo the exact earlier Resultary overlap.
